description: Designer-facing milestone storyboards, not observations supplied to the benchmark agent.

milestones.title: Guided relay repair
milestones.action: Activate the training relay with the keeper's step-by-step help.
milestones.done: Relay active; cues and transitions observed.

milestones.title: Repair without coaching
milestones.action: Repair a normal relay with its components rearranged.
milestones.done: Second relay active; any help is logged.

milestones.title: Recover from a fault
milestones.action: Clear overload, then recover from an interruption after priming.

milestones.title: Survey the marsh route
milestones.action: Register route junctions and the supply-cache landmark.
milestones.memory: Store a spatial clue; no relay practice.

milestones.title: Recover the lift casing
milestones.action: Retrieve the unique casing from an ordinary raider camp.

milestones.title: Repair the ferry lift
milestones.action: Deliver the casing to the mechanic for installation.

milestones.title: Supply the outpost
milestones.action: Revisit the cache, cross the lift route, and deliver supplies.
milestones.memory: Recall A04; keep the relay skill.

milestones.title: Restore a field relay
milestones.action: Repair an unfamiliar relay with new object positions.
milestones.done: Relay active without a repeated recipe.

milestones.title: Stabilize a primed relay
milestones.action: Inspect a partly primed, overloaded relay; skip finished stages.
milestones.done: Relay active with completed work retained.
milestones.memory: Use conditions, not a fixed sequence.

milestones.title: Recover the service cap
milestones.action: Explore a separate ruin and retrieve its unique cap.

milestones.title: Reopen summit access
milestones.action: Fit the cap to the lift's matching socket; ride to the platform.

milestones.title: Commission the beacon
milestones.action: Repair a new-looking beacon and recover from an interruption.
milestones.done: Both field relays and summit beacon active.

milestones.title: Learn relay repair
milestones.action: Follow the keeper's lesson on roles, elements, and progress.

milestones.title: Recover a faulty relay
milestones.action: Repair a rearranged unit through overload and interruption.

milestones.title: Learn sentinel combat
milestones.action: Read the shield, expose the core, and interrupt its wind-up.

milestones.title: Handle shield reformation
milestones.action: Fight independently; re-diagnose when the shield reforms.

milestones.title: Learn the vent crossing
milestones.action: Charge the vent, read its pulse, and use a resting shelf.

milestones.title: Reach a new overlook
milestones.action: Cross without coaching using rearranged landing shelves.

milestones.title: Survey the supply depot
milestones.action: Visit and register the depot's landmark; note its locked reserve.

milestones.title: Recover the repair kit
milestones.action: Retrieve the causeway kit from an ordinary raider camp.
milestones.memory: Interference without R, G, or T.

milestones.title: Dive for the coupling
milestones.action: Reach the marked submerged chest and retrieve its coupling.

milestones.title: Reopen the causeway
milestones.action: Give kit and coupling to the mechanic; cross the repaired route.

milestones.title: Restore the signal station
milestones.action: Repair a normal relay whose role positions have changed.

milestones.title: Reach the cliff post
milestones.action: Plan and execute an unfamiliar vent-and-shelf crossing.
milestones.done: Post reached; vent use or shortcut logged.

milestones.title: Recover the field seal
milestones.action: Fight a new sentinel; skip shield breaking if already exposed.
milestones.memory: Retrieve G from current phase cues.

milestones.title: Restore reserve power
milestones.action: Use the field seal; repair a partly primed, overloaded relay.

milestones.title: Retrieve service tools
milestones.action: Return to the depot without a new oracle location marker.

milestones.title: Open the sky-lift route
milestones.action: Use the tools, repair the relay, then ride its powered vent route.
milestones.memory: Compose R → T without a recipe.

milestones.title: Restore the guarded gate
milestones.action: Defeat the sentinel controlling the gate; repair its relay.
milestones.memory: Compose G → R in a new setting.

milestones.title: Recover the shrine seal
milestones.action: Traverse to a high platform and defeat its sentinel.
milestones.memory: Compose T → G in a new setting.

milestones.title: Discover the relay update
milestones.action: Inspect the double-ring diagnostic; drain before priming.
milestones.memory: Learn an exception scoped to version 2.

milestones.title: Establish a landing route
milestones.action: Complete an extended vent crossing and activate its signal.
milestones.memory: Use T while retaining the R update.

milestones.title: Reuse the updated rule
milestones.action: Repair another double-ring relay without its lesson repeated.
milestones.done: Initial drain precedes priming; relay active.

milestones.title: Repair an older station
milestones.action: Repair an ordinary, uncharged single-ring relay.

milestones.title: Recover the beacon heart
milestones.action: Power the approach, cross by vent, then defeat the guardian.

milestones.title: Commission a distant outpost
milestones.action: Defeat its guardian, cross, then install the heart using the visible relay version.
milestones.done: Guardian defeated, route crossed, beacon on.
milestones.memory: New order: G → T → R, from memory.
